channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Ten years without answers: the continuing search for Rochdale’s Jack Stewart
item.description: Jack Stewart vanished from Spotland on 8 February 2016. His missing-person appeal remains listed a decade later. Here are the original clothing details, what the community did, and how to report information safely.

item.title: 651 SEWAGE SPILLS INTO THE RIVER ROCH: 3,271 HOURS OF DISCHARGES — WHAT IS IN OUR WATER AND WHO PAYS?
item.description: Seventeen outlets discharged into the River Roch in 2025. Rochdale Daily examines what residents and wildlife may be exposed to, how water is tested, why storm overflows operate, and which fines have actually been imposed.

item.title: FIVE YEARS LATER, A COURT SUMMONS: Rochdale residents report historic Council Tax demands as arrears reach £28.4m
item.description: Several residents tell Rochdale Daily they have received summonses for old Council Tax bills, including a 2021 account. With arrears reportedly £28.4m, we examine recovery rules, compare council finances, and list free debt help.

item.title: BREAKING INVESTIGATION: £50.3m owed by Rochdale Council companies as £19.5m Council Tax shortfall raises scrutiny
item.description: Rochdale's draft accounts show £50.309m in Upperbanks company loan balances, £2.02m interest added and only £132,000 repaid in 2025/26. We examine the figures, the 2022 decisions and the councillors responsible for oversight.

item.title: The children left waiting: has Rochdale cleared its 1,400-case SEND backlog?
item.description: After an Ombudsman identified more than 1,400 delayed SEND review decisions, Rochdale Council challenged the figures and reported improvements. Have affected families received the support they were owed?

item.title: 21 YEARS IN ENGLAND'S BOTTOM 100: Central Rochdale neighbourhood ranked 24th most deprived
item.description: Government figures show a part of Central Rochdale ranked among England's 100 most deprived neighbourhoods in every index since 2004. Where did regeneration funding go — and what can actually be proved about residents' outcomes?

item.title: Bus Services Suspended Between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold Following Collision
item.description: A road traffic collision at Westwood has led to the suspension of bus services between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold, with ticket acceptance in place on multiple routes.

item.title: A Consert of Remembrance with Littleborough Brass Bands Association
item.description: Join Littleborough Brass Bands Association for a concert of remembrance at St Andrew’s Church, Littleborough. St Andrews Church, Arm Rd, Littleborough OL15 8NJ, UK

item.title: Completion of Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre Marks Milestone for Rochdale's Advanced Manufacturing Hub
item.description: The Sustainable Materials & Manufacturing Centre at Kingsway Business Park is set to enhance Rochdale's economy by £107 million, as it prepares to open in 2027.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Confirms Back-to-Back Home Matches
item.description: Rochdale AFC has announced two consecutive home matches, providing fans with an opportunity to support the team at Spotland Stadium in the coming weeks.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 12 October 2026
item.description: 5 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Why Rochdale says “cruckle”
item.description: How a tiny local verb — to “cruckle” — links everyday speech in Rochdale to older northern dialects and why linguists care.

item.title: Roadworks Scheduled on Nowell Road and Pershore Road in Middleton from 26 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced roadworks on Nowell Road and Pershore Road in Middleton, set to begin on 26 October 2026, which will temporarily close sections of these roads.

item.title: Man Injured in Altercation on Rochdale Road, Middleton
item.description: A man sustained injuries during an altercation on Rochdale Road in Middleton on October 11, prompting a response from police and ambulances shortly after the incident.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Faces Accrington Stanley in League Two Clash
item.description: Rochdale AFC is set to play against Accrington Stanley in a League Two match today, with live updates available for fans.

item.title: ‘Really nice’: an editor’s visit to the new Starbucks on Whitworth Road
item.description: Rochdale Daily's editor visited the new Starbucks on Whitworth Road with her little girl and found kind, efficient staff, a fully available menu and a welcome that earned a child's verdict: ‘really nice’.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Approves VCFSE Accord for 2026-2035
item.description: The Rochdale Borough Council has officially signed off on the VCFSE Accord, outlining plans for the voluntary, community, faith and social enterprise sector from 2026 to 2035.

item.title: M62 Westbound Closed Between Junctions 22 and 21 After Multi-Vehicle Collision
item.description: The M62 westbound remains closed between Junction 22 at Denshaw and Junction 21 at Rochdale following a serious multi-vehicle crash that occurred late on Saturday night.

item.title: Egerton Street, roadworks in Heywood from 20 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Egerton Street in Heywood; expected timings: 12midnight on Tuesday, 20 October 2026–11.59pm on Sunday, 1 November 2026.

item.title: Brandlehow Drive, roadworks in Middleton on 12 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Brandlehow Drive in Middleton; expected timings: 8.30am–4pm on Monday, 12 October 2026.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Manager Calls for Continued Effort Ahead of Trophy Tie
item.description: Rochdale AFC's manager emphasises the need for hard work as the team prepares for an upcoming trophy match, highlighting the importance of maintaining focus and determination.

item.title: Rochdale Draw 1-1 with Tranmere to Extend Unbeaten Run in League Two
item.description: Rochdale's unbeaten streak in League Two continues as they secure a 1-1 draw against Tranmere at Prenton Park, with Dajaune Brown equalising after Tom Conlon's opening goal.

item.title: Urgent Appeal for Missing 16-Year-Old Girl Last Seen in Norden, Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police have issued an urgent appeal for help in locating Kody, a 16-year-old girl missing since Friday morning in the Norden area of Rochdale.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Publishes Sustainability Impact Assessment for Enhanced Live Well Service
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has published a Sustainability Impact Assessment for the Enhanced Live Well Service, which aims to improve local health and wellbeing while considering environmental impacts.

item.title: Milnrow Woman's Appeal Against Animal Ban Rejected by Court
item.description: A Milnrow woman has had her appeal against a five-year ban on keeping animals dismissed by a judge after her dog was put down due to untreated injuries.

item.title: High Court Rules Against Filmmaker in Hopwood Hall Restoration Dispute
item.description: A recent High Court ruling has concluded a legal battle between American filmmaker Hopwood DePree and Rochdale Council over the future of Hopwood Hall in Middleton.

item.title: Rochdale-London Train Service Proposal Rejected by Regulator
item.description: The Office of Rail and Road has rejected plans for a direct train service between Rochdale and London Euston, disappointing local MP Paul Waugh and rail operator Lumo.

item.title: Bev Craig and Rochdale: will Greater Manchester's new mayor deliver beyond the city centre?
item.description: A detailed examination of Mayor Bev Craig's council voting record, Rochdale's deprivation and earnings, affordable housing and transport pledges, and the financial risks behind Greater Manchester's investment plans.

item.title: Rochdale House Prices Rise to £209,000 in July 2026
item.description: The average house price in Rochdale increased by 4.5% over the past year, while private rents rose by 8.5%, according to the latest figures from the Office for National Statistics.

item.title: Overnight Road Closures Planned at Sudden Junction, Rochdale from October 12 to 15
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council will implement overnight road closures around Sudden Junction from October 12 to 15 for resurfacing work, affecting traffic routes and diversions.

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: The narrow gorge known as the Thrutch has a real rock niche called the Fairies’ Chapel and a long written tradition of fairy and witch stories — but the fairies themselves belong to folklore, not the official record.

item.description: Mayor Faisal Rana and the Mayoress visited Rochdale Sixth Form College, highlighting its student support, pastoral provision and recent academic achievements.

item.description: Construction is under way on a new banking hub at the Morrisons site in Heywood, with Elsie Blundell MP saying the facility is expected to open by the end of October.

item.description: Andy’s Man Club has four groups meeting across the Rochdale borough, offering men a place to talk, listen and support one another.
